_readme: FIAT PLACES AND GAPS (9 Oct): the deeds (128x128, art/items/the_deeds.png), the Stats rail glyph (64x64, art/ui/stats.png), the three zones' tabs and the nine sites' bands (688x296, art/places/<slug>.png, UI.place_slug of the name). One file a job, written straight to its live name ('single').

Places follow Matt's two first pieces: the zones take art/places/the_estate.png as their style image, the sites art/places/ransacked_streets.png. Those two exist, so their jobs are skipped (a job whose file exists is skipped); --force would redo them - don't.
The game shows a place's art covering its box from the centre (cut top and bottom), shaded under the words; a zone tab is a thin strip from the middle. A missing place keeps the drawn skyline.
Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_places_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <slug> ++ --force).

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a bundle of old property deeds: thick folded parchment documents tied with faded pink legal ribbon, a red wax seal cracked at the edge, a council stamp in blue ink, corners dog-eared and water-stained, a rusted paperclip holding a typed schedule to the front, seen from above at a slight angle. One object centred and filling the frame, a single bold silhouette that still reads at a quarter of this size, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game item; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette with the ribbon and the seal the only warm colour, worn and handled, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no readable text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background.

A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a battered clipboard with a dog-eared record sheet clipped to it, a hand-drawn bar chart and a column of tally marks in pencil, a chewed pencil tucked under the clip, a coffee ring on the corner, front on. Pixel art, wide side-on panorama of a run-down 1970s British council estate at dusk: three grey concrete tower blocks with deck-access walkways, rows of pebble-dashed terraces in front, a burnt-out car, sodium streetlights just coming on, a few lit windows. Muted blue-grey and slate palette with sparse warm orange lights, low cloud. Quiet, not busy; no people, no text. The skyline's interest sits in a band across the middle of the frame (it is shown as a thin strip cut from the middle); flat, even detail side to side, darker at the bottom edge.
jobs._where: the zone tab (372x56, cut from the middle)

jobs.description: Pixel art, wide street-level view down a ransacked British terraced street after a collapse: front doors kicked in, curtains torn out, a mattress and bin bags in the road, a looted corner shop with its shutter half-up, a car on its rims, a council tower block behind the rooftops, overcast evening sky. Muted blue-grey palette, dark navy shadows, overcast evening light, one or two warm orange windows or lamps. The left third and the bottom quarter stay darker and lower in detail (the title and the timer sit there); the interest is in the centre. No people, no text, no readable signage or lettering.
